business_summary: Raj Consumer Care Limited manufactures and sells edible oil and cakes in India. The company offers refined groundnut, sunflower, soyabean, cottonseed, and rice bran oils, as well as filtered groundnut oil under the Guinea brand; coconut oil under the COCORAJ brand; filtered til oil under the Tilraj and Guinea brand; mustard oil under the Mustraj and Guinea brands; and blended til oil for pooja lamps under the Divya Shakti brand. It also provides edible oil seeds and related products. The company sells its products through e-commerce, quick commerce, and modern trade. The company was formerly known as Raj Oil Mills Limited and change its name to Raj Consumer Care Limited in October 2026. Raj Consumer Care Limited was founded in 1943 and is based in Mumbai, India.
